title: Canonical proper pushforward comparison is an isomorphism on limit sheaves
statement: Let Y be Noetherian, J a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, f:X\to Y proper, F coherent on X, and assume H=f_*F is coherent [def-weil-proper-morphism, pqf-def-coherent]. Let κ:H^\wedge\to(f_*(F/(J\mathcal O_X)^{n+1}F))_n be a morphism of inverse systems such that π^J_n κ_n=f_*(π^{J\mathcal O_X}_n) for every n\ge0 [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Then the induced map between the inverse limits, taken in the category of O_Y-module sheaves, is an isomorphism. No object G, map γ, or lifting conclusion is involved.

source.place: Theorem 02OC, degree zero, and first half of Lemma 088B; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OC and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088B

proof.text: Fix an affine open U=Spec A of Y, let I=J(U), H=f_*F and M=Gamma(U,H). Restrict f to f^(-1)U; properness and coherence persist. The affine ideal-product and quotient formulas identify the source section system with M/I^(n+1)M. The quotient projections are surjective, so hκ identifies the evaluated κ_n with the canonical degree-zero formal-functions maps.

Apply globalSections_formal_functions to the restricted proper morphism. Its specified projection equations identify the limit of these canonical maps with its isomorphism from the adic completion of M. Thus the inverse limit of the evaluated κ is an isomorphism on every affine open.

Evaluation of module sheaves preserves limits, by Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.Limits. Hence evaluation of lim.map κ is an isomorphism on every affine open. The inverses commute with restriction by cancellation. On a general open cover by affine opens, apply these inverses to the restrictions of a section; their agreement on smaller affine opens of overlaps lets the sheaf axiom glue a unique inverse section. The resulting inverse sheaf map is linear and inverse to lim.map κ because those equations hold on the affine basis.

proof_origin.place: Theorem 02OC, degree zero, and first half of Lemma 088B; explicit sheaf-limit formulation and categorical glue by G2

lean.statement:
theorem formalCompletion_pushforward_limit_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (F : CoherentModules X)
    (h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj))
    (κ : formalCompletionSystem J ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ⟶
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (hκ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ≫
        κ.app (op n) = (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj)) :
    IsIso (lim.map κ)
